turns.q: Can I trust Supertech as a builder? What happened with their delayed projects?
turns.answer:
No, you should avoid buying from Supertech Limited. Supertech is currently under active insolvency proceedings before the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), and its developments carry significant statutory, execution, and financial risks. 

The builder faced severe financial distress due to over-leveraging, failure to clear land premium dues owed to local development authorities, and widespread construction delays across projects in Noida and Greater Noida West. The situation culminated in the insolvency process, alongside the landmark Supreme Court order to demolish its illegal Twin Towers in Sector 93A, Noida.

For ongoing or ready-to-move projects like Supertech Eco Village 1, registries have been stalled or complicated due to uncleared authority dues and legal proceedings. Purchasing a home from a developer under insolvency means your capital is exposed to legal uncertainty, missing Occupancy Certificates (OC), and stalled sub-lease registrations.

turns.q: For a 1.4 crore flat in Noida, what is the total cost including stamp duty, registration and GST?
turns.answer:
### On ₹1.40 Cr

| Charge | Amount |
| :--- | ---: |
| Stamp duty (7%) | **₹9,80,000** |
| Stamp duty if a woman is primary owner (6%) | ₹8,40,000 |
| Registration (1%) | ₹1,40,000 |
| GST if under construction (5%) | ₹7,00,000 |
| GST if ready to move with OC | ₹0 |

Stamp duty is charged on the agreement value or the circle rate, whichever is higher, so the figure above is the floor. You also deduct 1% TDS (₹1,40,000) from the payment to the seller and deposit it with Form 26QB.

### Statutory taxes & registration charges (Uttar Pradesh)

These are set by law and are the same for every project.

| Component | Rate | Nature | Paid when & to whom |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stamp duty** | 7% of agreement or circle value, whichever is higher | Mandatory | At registry, to the UP Stamp & Registration Department |
| **Stamp duty — female primary owner** | 6% | Concession | At registry |
| **Registration fee** | 1% of value | Mandatory | At deed execution, to the Sub-Registrar |
| **GST — under construction** | 5% (without input tax credit) | Statutory | Billed across construction milestones |
| **GST — ready to move with OC** | 0% | Exempt | Not applicable once the Occupancy Certificate is granted |
| **TDS (Section 194-IA)** | 1% of sale consideration | Mandatory | Deducted by the buyer when value exceeds ₹50 Lakh (Form 26QB) |

### Budgeting
Allow 12–14% above base price for an under-construction home, or 8–9% above base price for ready-to-move with OC, to cover statutory and possession charges — typical for Noida — not verified for this project.
